confront.speaker: Stray Corusdeer
confront.text: A shape lifts its head from the tall grass, antlers catching the light — oaken-brown fading to a glow at the tips, cherry-red and warm enough to see the air shimmer above them. It watches you, unhurried. It has not decided you are a threat yet.

options.text: [Basic Command] Steady it. Slow words, open hands.
